Aisha, who asked until she understood, queried the Prophet's saying that whoever is called to account is punished, and he explained the easy reckoning as mere presentation of deeds.
A wound received in Allah's cause will appear on Resurrection Day bleeding but smelling of musk, and the Muslims, the last to come, will be foremost on that Day.
Believers will see their Lord like the full moon; the bridge over Hell, people brought out of Hell by their marks of prostration, and the last man to enter Paradise.
The Prophet will drive some people away from his Fount on the Day of Resurrection, as stray camels are driven from a trough.
Believers settle wrongs among themselves on a bridge before Paradise; Allah screens a believer, has him confess his sins and forgives them, while disbelievers and hypocrites are exposed.
Adam will be told to bring out 999 of every thousand for the Fire; people are gathered barefoot and naked, Abraham clothed first, and some companions taken to the Fire.
On the Day of Resurrection Noah says he conveyed the Message, his nation denies it, and the Prophet's followers testify for him, as the verse on a just nation describes.
People will be gathered barefoot, naked and uncircumcised, Abraham first clothed; some of the Prophet's companions will be driven to the left, and he will answer with Jesus's words.
Allah will screen the believer, make him confess his sins and forgive what He concealed in the world, while the disbelievers will be exposed before witnesses.
On the Day of Resurrection a huge fat man weighs nothing with Allah, and Death is brought as a ram and slaughtered, leaving Paradise's and Hell's people eternity without death.
People are gathered barefoot and naked, Abraham clothed first, some of the Prophet's companions are taken away, and Adam must send 999 of every thousand to the Fire.
Asked whether disbelievers will be gathered on their faces, the Prophet says the One who made them walk on their feet can make them walk on their faces.
Allah will lay bare His Shin and all believers will prostrate, but those who prostrated in the world to be seen will find their backs too stiff to bend.
Some will stand in sweat up to their ears before the Lord of the Worlds, and anyone whose account is questioned is ruined, the easy reckoning being only its presentation.
Allah will grasp the earth and roll up the heavens; the earth becomes bread, and people are gathered on white land, disbelievers on their faces, all barefoot, naked and uncircumcised.
On Resurrection Day people sweat to their ears, bloodshed is judged first, wrongs are repaid from good deeds, questioned accounts mean punishment, and a disbeliever would ransom himself with gold.
Believers will see their Lord plainly as sun and moon; a hooked bridge spans the Fire, prostration marks save the burnt, and the last man pleads his way into Paradise.
The Prophet precedes his people at the Lake-Fount, a month's journey wide, its water whiter than milk, countless cups; al-Kauthar, the abundant good given him, includes a river in Paradise.
Some companions will be driven from the Prophet's Lake-Fount, he being told they innovated and turned apostate after him; in a dream he saw such groups led to the Fire.
Between the Prophet's house and pulpit is a garden of Paradise, his pulpit stands over his Lake-Fount, and he will be his people's predecessor there.
The Lake-Fount is as wide as from Medina to Sana', its vessels countless as stars, and some will be taken from it for turning on their heels after the Prophet.
The Prophet will precede his people at the Lake-Fount, whose drinkers never thirst, but some will be pulled away for turning apostate and changing the religion after him.
A man asking about the Hour, who had prepared little but loved Allah and His Apostle, was told he will be with those he loves.
On Resurrection Noah's people will deny he conveyed Allah's message, and Muhammad's followers will testify for him; the Prophet recited the verse making them a just nation of witnesses.
Believers will see their Lord like the full moon; each people follows what it worshipped, a bridge spans Hell, believers intercede, and the last man out of Hell enters Paradise.
On Resurrection Allah will call Adam, and a voice will order him to bring out from his offspring those sent to the Fire.
The last man to leave Hell is given Paradise ten times the world; each person's Lord will speak to him, Fire ahead, so shield yourself even with half a date.
Each person will come close to his Lord, who will screen him from others, make him confess his sins, and forgive them as He screened them in the world.
